user.title: HomeKit Extended
user.description: Choose the kind of HomeKit accessory to publish.

air_purifier.title: Air purifier
air_purifier.description: Publish a fan and optional sensors as one HomeKit Air Purifier accessory.

data_description.port: Each accessory needs its own port. Avoid ports used by the HomeKit Bridge integration.
data_description.pin: 8-digit setup code in the format 123-45-678. A random code is suggested.
data_description.fan: Controls purifier power, speed, oscillation and auto mode (a preset named "auto").
data_description.air_quality_sensor: A HomeKit 1-5 quality value or an AQI-style value.
data_description.pm25_sensor: PM2.5 density in µg/m³. Used to estimate air quality when no air quality sensor is set.
data_description.filter_life_sensor: Remaining filter life in percent. HomeKit asks for a replacement at 10% or less.

irrigation.title: Irrigation system
irrigation.description: Publish valves as the zones of one HomeKit Irrigation System accessory.

data_description.port: Each accessory needs its own port. Avoid ports used by the HomeKit Bridge integration.
data_description.pin: 8-digit setup code in the format 123-45-678. A random code is suggested.
data_description.valves: Each valve becomes a zone of one Irrigation System accessory.
data_description.default_duration: How long a zone runs when started from Apple Home, up to 3600 seconds. The valve closes automatically when it ends. Can be changed per zone in Apple Home.

error.invalid_pin: Use the format 123-45-678. Repeated digits, 123-45-678 and 876-54-321 are not allowed by HomeKit.
error.port_in_use: This port is already used by another HomeKit accessory or bridge.
